ratings_why.fun: Gusts are real attacks, so they fire every other tribe's attack text, and Defer crowns a favourite from any tribe; the seating and 'who is biggest' puzzle changes every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Defer and the Gale carried into the shop are fresh, but the core is still 'extra attacks', which reads close to Windfury.

verdict_why: The web of Gust, Defer and biggest already holds; the only real fix is one ruling on Sir Vane, and more rounds would mostly reshuffle the Gale readers.

points.text: Sir Vane's 'your side attacks first' has no rule for two Vanes meeting; say that if both sides have one, the usual more-units rule decides.

Windhover still works under Lady High Pressure: a Gust is an attack, so seated right of the favourite it adds a Gust off the Deferred ones. The build notes call this a clash; it's a hidden combo worth saying on the card.

Pine-Cone Augur, Red Sky at Night, Mackerel Sky and The Sí Gaoithe all just check a Gale threshold. One of them could read where or by whom Gusts were made, so the shop side also asks a seating question.
Gale Warning is the best cross-tribe toy here (Hunter quarry, Cleave neutral, the Shy sell trick); keep it aimed and stackable.
Old Föhn's Defer plus soaking makes him a great back-row anchor; saying whether he also soaks Bristle damage would open a clear answer to the Bog folk counter.

standouts.why: Turning the whole board into Deferrers flips which units you want and clashes with Swift Couriers, a real build choice.
Reads only its left neighbour, so seating is the decision, and it chains off Gusts as well as normal attacks.
Defers until the Gale hits 6, so you time opening Gusts to light its fuse before the first normal attack.

weakest.why: A plain gold reader with one threshold; no decision once Gust Pages are down.
A threshold stat seed that does the same thing every turn.
Board-wide stats at a Gale step; strong but only says 'Gust more'.

flags.note: Two Sir Vanes meeting has no ruling.
Not clear whether 'damage dealt back' includes Bristle and other on-hit damage.
The mass Gust at 20 plus Lord Mistral's kill chains can make very long fights.
Warnings stack permanently each turn at Gale 8 or more; linear, but worth the owner's eye late.
With Old Föhn and The Swift Couriers, the favourite may be near unkillable.
